title: DelegationReceiptPayload
description: The decoded payload of a delegation receipt (format trooth.delegation-receipt.v1): what api.trooth.co recorded when a person in a workspace created or revoked a delegation to an agent, and when. It travels as an Ed25519 compact JWS with the header {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"trooth-delegation-receipt+jwt","kid":"trooth-evidence-2026-10"}, the payload being these members as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces), signed with the key /public/keys publishes with purpose signed-references. It says what Trooth recorded, not that any action under the delegation is proper. The limit, data class and approval threshold are bound through delegation.sha256. docs/ACTION-EVIDENCE.md; built by delegationReceiptPayload in trooth-os-worker-f src/action-authz.ts.

iat.description: When Trooth recorded the event, in seconds since the epoch (recorded_at, truncated).

recorded_at.description: When Trooth recorded the event (RFC 3339, milliseconds).

by.description: The id of the person who acted.

approval.description: How the creation was approved. Present on a created receipt; a revocation carries none.

delegation.description: The delegation the event is about.

meaning.description: What the receipt says, in one or two sentences.

delegation.title: DelegationReceiptDelegation
delegation.description: The delegation, by id and digest, with its principal, agent, target, actions and expiry.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the delegation document's canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces); the document carries the limit, data class, approval threshold and role.

principal.description: The workspace and the person who delegated.

agent.description: The agent's DPoP key, by thumbprint.

kid.description: The kid of the key that signed it; the same as the JWS header's.
